args.message: All five of the top-selling products in 2025 were beverages. Tangaroo sold the most, with 93,483 units, and the five are within about 530 units of each other. The best-selling jaffle, "nutellaphone who dis?", sold 28,396 units, so it is far behind. Each sales line in the data is one unit, so units sold is the count of lines on orders placed in 2025.
